summary: Beyond Meat filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing the September 18, 2026 post-trial ruling in Sonate (Vegadelphia) v. Dunkin and Beyond Meat, Case No. 6:22-cv-00812 (M.D. Fla.). The court reduced jury actual damages from $23.5M to $37,500 but upheld $15.4M in disgorgement, entering a $15,437,500 judgment; Sonate's prejudgment-interest and disgorgement-increase motions were denied. No securities transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are involved. Watch for post-trial motions or appeals, and any balance-sheet or liquidity impact given Beyond Meat's capital position.
